name: docsqa-linked-docs-v5-development
task: rank canonical technical-documentation pages and evaluate grounded answers for real support questions
optional_diagnostics: p95_latency_ms when recorded by a complete run
graph and storage statistics when recorded

aspect_annotated_retrieval_metrics.eligibility: only questions with frozen model-reviewed silver aspects; answer-only aspects without a local documentation ID are excluded from retrieval denominators
aspect_annotated_retrieval_metrics.purpose: measure whether retrieved documents jointly cover complementary answer requirements rather than merely matching any linked page

aspect_annotated_agent_metrics.eligibility: questions with at least one critical aspect supported by a pinned local documentation ID
aspect_annotated_agent_metrics.failure_policy: agent failures remain in the denominator with zero coverage and an incorrect outcome

system_setting.evaluation_status: development/exploratory because this pool was reused during system iteration
system_setting.publication_test_requirement: evaluate a newly collected disjoint post-freeze cohort once

judge_weak_supervision_overlay.purpose: evaluator-only split for tuning, selecting, freezing, and confirming the answer judge; it does not alter agent execution

calibration_validation.use: select a candidate and freeze the exact rubric, prompt, thresholds, and model settings

final_test.use: one post-freeze evaluator confirmation; no evaluator edit may follow inspection

judge_weak_supervision_overlay.execution_status: complete: the selected evaluator passed calibration train, calibration validation, and the frozen final test
judge_weak_supervision_overlay.holdout_scope: prospective for current judge-rule optimization only; all records previously participated in dataset construction and normalization
judge_weak_supervision_overlay.confirmatory_answer_quality_requirement: the frozen judge must pass the final_test gates before its agent answer-quality scores are confirmatory
judge_weak_supervision_overlay.confirmatory_answer_quality_status: evaluator requirement satisfied; system measurements on the reused 361-question development partition remain exploratory

legacy_development_check.status: historical development evidence; not the current final test

frozen_retrieval_parameters.graph_fusion: equal-weight RRF over the exact hybrid ranking and bounded graph ranking

qrel_provenance: distinct in-corpus documentation pages explicitly linked in accepted public support answers
unjudged_policy: zero measured gain; do not claim exhaustive irrelevance
fairness_controls: same agent and non-KB tools for plugin comparisons
retrieved canonical IDs logged before generation
